reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin primarily focused on deterministic subagent delegation, including model selection, dependency gating, personas, run tracking, and status presentation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供支持按次选择模型、依赖门控、角色人设和运行花名册的子代理委派工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with subagent delegation supporting per-call model selection, dependency gating, personas, and a durable run roster.

capabilities: Selects and routes per-call models through configured providers
Enforces task dependencies and delegation depth limits
Persists delegation state in workspace files when enabled
Exposes local configuration and status API routes
Renders delegation and roster status in the web interface
